title: Te Toto Tuatahi i Ringihia i roto i te Hae
intro: Whakaarohia ngā rā tōmua o te tangata, i te wā i noho whānau kotahi ai te ao katoa. Ka mātakitaki koe i ngā whakahere e rua e whakatakotoria ana ki te aroaro o Allah - tētahi e manakohia ana, tētahi e whakakahoretia ana. Ka pū te hae i roto i te ngākau, ā, ka hāhā te riri. Ko ngā mea e whai ake nei ka waiho he tohu ki te hītori ake ake, ā, ka noho ko tētahi manu iti hei kaiako.
clues: Nō te whānau tuatahi rawa ahau i runga i te whenua.
I hoatu e au he whakahere ki a Allah, engari kāore i manakohia taku, ko te whakahere anō i manakohia.
I kōrero ahau me te hae, me te whakawehi ki te tango i te ora.
Nāku i patu te tuatahi i te whenua, i te kore tika.
I kite ahau i tētahi rākau e waru ana i te whenua hei whakaatu mai ki ahau me pēhea te huna i tētahi tūpāpaku.
I mahue iho ahau i te pouri, ā, i roto ahau i te hunga i hinga mō ngā mahi a ōku ringa.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ko Qabil (Kaina), te tama a Ātama
Ko Samiri, te kaihanga o te kuao kau
Ko Namrud, te kaitukino i totohe ki a Ibrahim
Ko Azar, te kaihanga whakapakoko
Ko Kan'an, te tama a Noa i toremi
identity.answer: Ko Qabil (Kaina), te tama a Ātama

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I kohurutia tētahi teina/tuākana i te hae i muri i te whakakorenga o te whakahere
Te hanga i tētahi pourewa tiketike hei tiro atu ki te rangi
Te hanga i tētahi kuao kau koura mō te karakia
Te tono kia horahia he tēpu i te rangi
Te ārahi i tētahi ope taua arewhana ki te whakangaro i te Kaaba
trial.answer: I kohurutia tētahi teina/tuākana i te hae i muri i te whakakorenga o te whakahere

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He rākau e waru ana i te whenua hei whakaatu i te tanumanga
He kuao kau koura i tangi
He āka nui i runga i ngā wai waipuke
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He tēpu kua horahia ki te kai mai i te rangi
location.answer: He rākau e waru ana i te whenua hei whakaatu i te tanumanga

outcome.label: Hua
options: I pouri, ā, i roto i te hunga i hinga
I toremi i te waipuke nui
I horomia e te whenua me te taonga
I pāngia ia e te repera mō ngā tau e whitu
I whakawhiwhia ki tētahi rangatiratanga hei whakahaere i ngā hau
outcome.answer: I pouri, ā, i roto i te hunga i hinga

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
